frequency_question: How often are complex thirty-year bilateral resource treaties successfully renewed or extended within the final year prior to expiration?
membership_rule: Includes any formal bilateral water or transboundary river treaty with a duration of thirty years that reached its expiration phase and required administrative renewal steps.

cases.name: Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase Reviews

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named historical major long-term transboundary water treaty renewal cycles; total population estimated at 4 comparable instances globally.
known_gaps: Limited global set of 30-year bilateral water treaties reaching expiration in the modern era.
skeleton: Bilateral technical committee review (90 days) + inter-ministerial draft harmonization (60 days) + legal vetting and cabinet approval (45 days) + execution of signing ceremony (15 days); total sequential physical process time = 210 days. Available window = 132 days.
multiplier: 132 days available / 210 days required physical process duration
validity_reason: Bilateral diplomatic administrative procedures and bureaucratic timelines for treaty renewals remain stable over multi-year periods.
